rows.grounds: nom. sg. m. of caru (ritual oblation); L1/L2: 'caruḥ sādhyo'thavā' — the oblation is to be prepared.
sandhi: sādhyaḥ + athavā; sādhya (gerundive, to be accomplished/prepared) + athavā (or); L1/L2: 'caruḥ sādhyo'thavā' — the oblation is to be prepared, or alternatively.

sandhi: śiṣyaiḥ + homena; śiṣyaiḥ (instr. pl. of śiṣya, disciple) + homena (instr. sg. of homa, fire offering); L1/L2: 'śiṣyairhomena samakālakaḥ' — performed by the disciples with a fire offering at the same time.
nom. sg. m. adj., sama-kālaka (at the same time); L1/L2: 'śiṣyairhomena samakālakaḥ' — simultaneous with the fire offering by the disciples.
loc. sg. m. of caru (oblation); L1/L2: 'carau ca vīradravyāṇi' — and in the oblation, the heroic substances.
indeclinable conjunction; L1/L2: 'carau ca vīradravyāṇi' — and in the oblation.
nom./acc. pl. n. compound vīra-dravyāṇi (heroic substances/offerings); L1/L2: 'vīradravyāṇi laukikānyathavecchayā' — heroic substances, or worldly ones according to wish.

sandhi: laukikāni + athavā + icchayā; laukikāni (nom./acc. pl. n. of laukika, worldly) + athavā (or) + icchayā (instr. sg. of icchā, wish/desire); L1/L2: 'laukikānyathavecchayā' — or worldly ones, according to wish.
